environment.competingLoad: Independent user GPU tasks may be active; machine-wide load is not controlled by this harness.

scenario.page: Actual production DOMStage with six independently attached Family H fields; real shared scheduler with scroll-driven uniforms.
scenario.deadline: 110% of per-run idle median rAF; >=95% completed CPU+queue work inside deadline and median workload rAF inside deadline.
scenario.cpuBoundary: First field custom onBeforeFrame hook to shared queue completion; earlier automatic hooks on that first field are excluded. Capture is asynchronous and does not serialize rAF.
scenario.css: Public production bindCSSParameters; 0/1/8 selected bindings, 30 warmup +120 manually sampled visible frame hooks, no GPU rendering in timing region.

firstFrameCaptures.clock: Node wall time from navigation start, including browser protocol/readiness checks
firstFrameCaptures.firstFrameBoundary: Browser monotonic performance.now from each actual attach call to its first submitted GPU work completion. Shader compilation, input setup and first-frame encoding are included. This is GPU queue completion, not a browser paint timestamp; source-module/navigation time before attach is excluded.
